Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W03
Accountable role (person not assigned): Frontend/integration engineer with scientist

Outcome: A selected visualization workflow consumes existing versioned data or reports through normal access contracts.

Acceptance:
- Choose one concrete review need with pilot users and integrate an existing viewer/report surface; do not add another numerical recipe.
- Preserve exact release/result lineage and current authority on previews, thumbnails, caching and reports; isolate untrusted report content.
- Qualify accessibility and realistic payload/resource behavior. SITE01 makes this a launch dependency only if the chosen beta requires it; otherwise retain as later work.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/vision.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: W03: Integrate bounded image or QA report inspection when required
